workflow_pattern: This is a 'F7_pure_automation' style workflow. It requires the following operations, in roughly this order: create repository, add readme with content, create workflow auto comment uniform, validate automation with test issues. The task should combine these operations into one coherent, realistic request without listing them as separate steps.
question:
Hi! I'm a first-time maintainer working on learning GitHub automation and I really need your help. Could you please help me create a new project repository named welcome-bot-repo? I need to initialize it with just the main branch and include an initial README.md file with the content "# Welcome Bot Repo

A repository to test GitHub automation for greeting new issue authors." I'm struggling with GitHub automation workflows and would really appreciate your help developing a script that automatically adds a comment 'Welcome, thanks for opening this!' to any new issue created. After we set up the automation script, I need to test it by creating three sample issues with different titles ("Crash on startup", "Add export to CSV", "Typo in installation guide"). I'm really grateful for any assistance you can provide!
